en.summary: Earwax can block hearing. NHS: pharmacy drops to soften; do not use cotton buds. See GP/audiology if not clearing, pain, discharge, or after ear surgery/perforation history. No inventing irrigation protocols beyond clinical advice.
seeDoctorIf: Ear pain, discharge, or hearing loss after drops
History of perforated eardrum / ear surgery
selfCare: Pharmacy softening drops as directed; no cotton buds
doNot: Do not insert cotton buds or objects
Do not invent home syringing if advised against

fr.summary: Le cérumen peut boucher l'oreille. Gouttes pharmacie ; pas de coton-tige. Médecin si échec, douleur, écoulement.

he.summary: שעווה עלולה לסתום. טיפות בבית מרקחת; לא מקלוני צמר גפן. רופא בכישלון, כאב, הפרשות.

ru.summary: Сера может блокировать слух. Аптечные капли; не ватные палочки. Врач при неудаче, боли, отделяемом.
